name: Tea & Sympathy
source:
"My mother disowned me when I died. Now she's trying to make things right.
What does she really want from me?"

A short kinetic novel exploring family drama through the eyes of a vampire.
translation:
“我死后，我母亲与我断绝了关系。现在她正在努力扭转局面。
她到底想从我这里得到什么？”

一部简短的动态小说，通过吸血鬼的视角探索家庭戏剧。
